generic.Defined scope/population: All written and earned premium by channel code, line of business and region held in the EDW distribution mart
generic.In-scope period: Trailing eight quarters ending at the agreed as-of date stated in the baseline filename
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Channel code, line of business, region, written premium and earned premium populated on every row
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total channel premium ties to policy administration general-ledger premium within 0.5 percent
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Baseline workbook saved to the distribution strategy folder with as-of date and locked source tabs
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmapped or blank channel codes listed as Unassigned with the remap decision recorded
generic.Test population: Every premium row in the published eight-quarter channel baseline extract
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Reconciliation variance to the general ledger at or below 0.5 percent and zero null channel codes
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped channel premium is routed to the Sales Operations Analyst for taxonomy remap before publication
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Baseline shows premium by channel, line and region for eight quarters with a signed reconciliation tab
generic.Evidence location: Distribution strategy folder baseline workbook plus the BI channel baseline dataset

steps.title: Extract eight quarters of channel premium from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query the EDW distribution mart for written and earned premium by channel code, line of business and region
Set the period filter to the trailing eight quarters ending at the agreed as-of date
Record the extract date, filters applied and row count on a provenance tab
Done when the eight-quarter channel premium extract is saved with its provenance tab
verify: Confirm the extract covers eight consecutive quarters with no missing period
Pass when row counts and period coverage match the documented extract parameters

steps.title: Reconcile extracted channel premium to the policy administration general ledger
sop: Total the extracted premium by quarter and compare it to the general-ledger premium for the same periods
Calculate the variance percentage per quarter and investigate any quarter above the 0.5 percent tolerance
Document the cause and value of each residual variance on the reconciliation tab
Done when every quarter reconciles within tolerance or carries a documented variance explanation
verify: Check the reconciliation tab shows a variance figure for every quarter in scope
Pass when no quarter exceeds the 0.5 percent tolerance without a written explanation

steps.title: Map legacy and blank channel codes to the current taxonomy in Microsoft Excel
sop: List every distinct channel code in the extract and join it to the approved channel taxonomy
Assign each legacy or retired code to its current taxonomy equivalent and record the mapping rule
Bucket premium with no resolvable code as Unassigned rather than forcing it into a channel
Done when every premium row carries a current taxonomy channel or the Unassigned label
verify: Run a distinct count of channel codes after mapping and confirm all sit in the taxonomy
Pass when no premium row carries a null or unrecognised channel code

steps.title: Split new business and renewal premium per channel in the baseline workbook
sop: Apply the transaction type flag from the EDW to separate new business from renewal premium
Build the mix view showing new business share and renewal share by channel and quarter
Check that new business plus renewal equals total premium for every channel and quarter
Done when the new business versus renewal split is complete and foots to total premium
verify: Recompute the sum of new business and renewal premium against the channel total
Pass when the split foots to total premium for every channel and quarter

steps.title: Publish the channel baseline view in the BI reporting platform
sop: Load the reconciled baseline dataset into the BI reporting platform with channel, line and region dimensions
Build the baseline report showing premium trend by channel over the eight quarters
Spot-check three channels in BI against the workbook figures to confirm the load is faithful
Done when the BI baseline report renders figures identical to the reconciled workbook
verify: Compare the BI channel totals to the workbook totals for the latest quarter
Pass when BI and workbook channel totals agree exactly

steps.title: Review and lock the baseline workbook with the Head of Distribution
sop: Walk the reconciliation, taxonomy mapping and mix split with the Distribution Analyst
Confirm the Unassigned premium value is acceptable or send it back for further mapping
Approve the baseline and record the approval date on the workbook cover tab
Done when the baseline is approved and the source tabs are locked against edits
verify: Check the cover tab carries the approver name, approval date and as-of date
Pass when the baseline is approved and the source tabs cannot be edited

generic.Defined scope/population: Every channel listed in the approved channel taxonomy from independent agent through to embedded
generic.In-scope period: The current channel strategy planning cycle up to the value proposition sign-off date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target segment, primary need, proof point and service commitments stated for each channel
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of value proposition pages equals the count of channels in the taxonomy
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated value proposition pack held with the review log in the distribution strategy folder
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Channels without an agreed proposition logged with the blocking issue and owner
generic.Test population: All channel value proposition pages issued for review in this cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: One dated proposition per taxonomy channel and zero out-of-target-market product references
generic.Exception handling path: Propositions naming a product outside target market return to the Distribution Analyst for rewrite
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each proposition names segment, need, proof point and service commitments and carries reviewer sign-off
generic.Evidence location: Distribution strategy folder value proposition pack and the CRM channel reference record

steps.title: Confirm the channel list from the approved taxonomy in Microsoft Excel
sop: Pull the current channel taxonomy and list every channel requiring a value proposition
Remove retired channels and add any channel launched since the last cycle
Circulate the confirmed channel list to the Head of Distribution for agreement
Done when the channel list for this cycle is agreed and dated
verify: Compare the list against the taxonomy reference data
Pass when every active taxonomy channel appears on the confirmed list

steps.title: Assemble segment and buying evidence from the CRM for each channel
sop: Pull segment mix and win reasons by channel from CRM opportunity and account data
Summarise for each channel who buys there today and the stated reason they chose it
Flag channels where the evidence is too thin to assert a proposition
Done when each channel has an evidence summary or a thin-evidence flag
verify: Check every channel on the confirmed list has an evidence summary attached
Pass when no channel proceeds to drafting without evidence or an explicit flag

steps.title: Draft the one-page value proposition per channel in Microsoft Excel
sop: Write one page per channel stating who it serves and why the customer buys there
State the target segment, the primary need met and the proof point of price advice speed or appetite
Keep each page to a single page so the proposition stays a decision tool not a brochure
Done when a drafted page exists for every channel on the confirmed list
verify: Count drafted pages against the confirmed channel list
Pass when the page count equals the channel count with no gaps

steps.title: Add the carrier service commitments per channel to each proposition
sop: State the quote turnaround, underwriting access and marketing support the carrier commits to that channel
Check each commitment against what distribution operations can actually deliver today
Mark any commitment that requires a capability not yet in place as conditional
Done when every proposition carries deliverable service commitments
verify: Review the commitments with distribution operations for feasibility
Pass when no commitment is stated that operations cannot support or has not flagged conditional

steps.title: Cross-check each proposition against the approved product target market
sop: List the products referenced in each channel proposition
Compare each reference to the approved product target market statement for that channel
Strike or rewrite any claim that promises a product the channel cannot legitimately place
Done when every product reference sits inside the approved target market
verify: Sample every proposition for product references and test them against target market
Pass when no proposition names a product outside the channel target market

steps.title: Circulate for product and marketing sign-off and record comments in the review log
sop: Issue the proposition pack to product and marketing leads with a stated response date
Capture every comment in the review log with raiser, channel affected and disposition
Apply accepted changes and reissue the affected pages
Done when each reviewer has signed off or their dissent is logged
verify: Check the review log for a recorded response from every named reviewer
Pass when all reviewers are logged as signed off or explicitly dissenting

generic.Defined scope/population: Every active product line crossed with every channel in the approved channel taxonomy
generic.In-scope period: The current filing and appointment position as at the eligibility matrix effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each matrix cell marked Eligible, Eligible with approval or Not eligible with no blanks
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix cell count equals active product lines multiplied by active channels
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved eligibility matrix versioned and dated before hand-off to distribution operations
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Licence, registration and jurisdiction restrictions logged against the affected cell with a decision
generic.Test population: All product-by-channel cells in the issued eligibility matrix
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero blank cells and zero eligible pairings in unfiled jurisdictions
generic.Exception handling path: Cells failing the filing or licence check are set to Not eligible pending compliance clearance
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Matrix covers every product line and channel with jurisdiction and licence restrictions recorded
generic.Evidence location: Eligibility matrix workbook and the product authorisation rules in the producer management system

steps.title: Extract the active product line list from the policy administration system
sop: Pull the active product lines and their filed jurisdictions from the policy administration system
Exclude products withdrawn or in run-off and note them separately
Record the extract date so the matrix reflects a stated filing position
Done when the active product line and jurisdiction list is extracted and dated
verify: Compare the product count to the current product catalogue
Pass when every active product line appears in the extract

steps.title: Build the product-by-channel eligibility grid in Microsoft Excel
sop: Create one row per product line and one column per channel from the approved taxonomy
Mark each cell Eligible, Eligible with approval or Not eligible using the strategy position
Leave no cell blank so silence is never read as permission
Done when every cell in the grid carries an eligibility marking
verify: Run a blank-cell check across the whole grid
Pass when the grid contains zero blank cells

steps.title: Record jurisdiction restrictions against each eligible cell
sop: For each Eligible cell compare the filed jurisdictions to the states the channel operates in
Record the state or jurisdiction restriction where the product is not filed everywhere
Downgrade to Not eligible where the channel operates only in unfiled jurisdictions
Done when every eligible cell carries its jurisdiction restriction note
verify: Sample eligible cells against the filing extract
Pass when no cell is eligible in a jurisdiction where the product is unfiled

steps.title: Flag licence and registration constraints in the producer management system
sop: Identify products needing a licence or registration the channel does not universally hold
Check variable products, surplus lines, crop and flood against producer qualification data
Mark the affected cells Eligible with approval and state the qualification required
Done when every qualification-constrained pairing is flagged with its requirement
verify: Test flagged cells against producer licence and appointment records
Pass when every qualification-constrained pairing carries its stated requirement

steps.title: Confirm each eligible pairing against the product target-market statement
sop: Read each eligible pairing against the approved target-market statement for that product
Note the justification where the eligibility is deliberately narrower than the target market
Escalate any pairing that appears wider than target market for correction
Done when every eligible pairing is consistent with target market or justified
verify: Review the justification notes on narrowed pairings
Pass when no eligible pairing exceeds the approved product target market

steps.title: Hand the approved matrix to distribution operations for system configuration
sop: Version and date the approved matrix and record the approver
Issue it to distribution operations as the configuration specification for product authorisation rules
Agree the configuration target date and the validation approach in the producer management system
Done when the versioned matrix is handed over with an agreed configuration date
verify: Confirm receipt and the configuration date from distribution operations
Pass when the hand-over is acknowledged against the versioned matrix

generic.Defined scope/population: All channels carried in the strategy with their hold, grow and exit investment options
generic.In-scope period: The channel strategy planning horizon covered by the draft document
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Current state, target mix, options, trade-offs, risks and decision request all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium and expense figures in the draft tie to the baseline and economics appendices
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft saved with version number and date and its appendices attached
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Figures without a traceable source flagged and resolved before the draft is circulated
generic.Test population: Every numeric figure and option set in the draft channel strategy document
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: At least two options per channel and zero figures lacking a source reference
generic.Exception handling path: Unsourced figures are returned to the Distribution Analyst for tracing or removal
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft contains option sets, explicit trade-offs and a numbered decision log at the front
generic.Evidence location: Distribution strategy folder draft document with baseline and economics appendices

steps.title: Set the document structure in Microsoft Excel and agree the storyline
sop: Structure the draft as current state, target mix, investment options, trade-offs, risks and decision request
Agree the storyline with the Distribution Analyst before content is written
Fix the page budget per section so the pack stays decision-sized
Done when the agreed structure and section owners are recorded
verify: Check the skeleton contains all six required sections
Pass when every section has a named owner and a page budget

steps.title: Populate current state from the approved channel revenue baseline
sop: Insert the current channel mix, premium and trend from the approved baseline workbook
Reference the baseline version and as-of date beside each figure
Avoid restating figures that differ from the baseline without an explanation
Done when the current state section is populated with referenced baseline figures
verify: Trace three current state figures back to the baseline workbook
Pass when each traced figure matches the baseline exactly

steps.title: Build the hold, grow and exit option set per channel in the BI reporting platform
sop: Model at least two investment options per channel covering hold, grow or exit
Show the premium and expense impact of each option over the planning horizon
Use the approved economics model outputs rather than fresh assumptions
Done when every channel carries at least two costed options
verify: Count the options presented per channel
Pass when no channel has fewer than two costed investment options

steps.title: State the explicit funding trade-off for each growth option
sop: For each growth option name what gets defunded to pay for it
Quantify the reduction in the defunded channel or activity
Avoid presenting any growth option as cost-free
Done when every growth option carries a quantified trade-off
verify: Review each growth option for a named and quantified trade-off
Pass when no growth option is presented without its funding source

steps.title: Attach the baseline and channel economics outputs as appendices
sop: Attach the channel revenue baseline and channel economics outputs as numbered appendices
Cross-reference each figure in the body to its appendix table
Flag any figure with no traceable appendix source for correction
Done when every body figure carries an appendix reference
verify: Sample body figures and follow their appendix references
Pass when no figure lacks a traceable source reference

steps.title: Write the numbered decision log at the front of the draft
sop: List the decisions required from the executive sponsor as a numbered log
State for each decision the options, the recommendation and the consequence of deferring
Place the log at the front so the ask is visible before the analysis
Done when the numbered decision log is complete and positioned at the front
verify: Check every option set in the body maps to a numbered decision
Pass when no option set is presented without a corresponding decision request

generic.Defined scope/population: All active channels with their acquisition cost, cost-to-serve and margin contribution components
generic.In-scope period: The financial periods agreed for the economics assessment with matching expense boundaries
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Commission, override, marketing, field salary, servicing volumes and loss data populated per channel
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Commission and override expense ties to the finance expense ledger before feeding the margin calculation
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Economics model versioned with the allocation basis documented on a dedicated tab
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Channels below the target margin hurdle flagged with the reason and follow-up owner
generic.Test population: Every active channel row in the channel economics model
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Commission reconciliation variance to the ledger at zero and every channel carrying an allocation basis
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled commission expense is returned to the billing platform owner before the model is published
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Model shows acquisition cost, cost-to-serve and margin contribution for every active channel
generic.Evidence location: Channel economics model workbook plus the EDW expense and premium extracts

steps.title: Compute acquisition cost per channel in the channel economics model
sop: Gather commission, override, marketing spend and field salary loading by channel
Divide the total acquisition spend by new policies acquired to get cost per acquisition
State the loading basis used for field salary rather than leaving it implicit
Done when acquisition cost per channel is computed with its components visible
verify: Recompute acquisition cost for two channels from the component figures
Pass when the recomputed values match the model output

steps.title: Derive cost-to-serve per channel from policy and service transaction volumes
sop: Pull endorsement, call and billing contact volumes per channel from the EDW
Apply the agreed unit cost per transaction type to produce servicing cost per channel
Express the result as a per-policy rate so channels of different sizes compare
Done when cost-to-serve per in-force policy is computed for every channel
verify: Check the transaction volumes used reconcile to the source service reporting
Pass when volumes tie to source and every channel carries a per-policy rate

steps.title: Reconcile commission and override expense from the billing platform to the ledger
sop: Extract commission, override and contingent commission by channel from the billing and commission platform
Compare the total to the finance expense ledger for the same period
Resolve or document any variance before the figures enter the margin calculation
Done when commission expense is reconciled to the ledger and signed off
verify: Review the reconciliation working for a stated variance and its cause
Pass when the commission total ties to the ledger or the variance is documented

steps.title: Calculate combined ratio and margin contribution by channel
sop: Combine earned premium, incurred loss and the allocated expense stack per channel
Compute combined ratio and margin contribution for each channel
Document the expense allocation basis used on the allocation tab
Done when combined ratio and margin contribution are produced for every channel
verify: Check each channel margin figure has a stated allocation basis
Pass when no margin figure exists without a documented allocation basis

steps.title: Rank channels by margin per dollar of acquisition spend
sop: Divide margin contribution by acquisition spend for each channel
Rank the channels on that ratio and compare each against the target hurdle
Flag every channel falling below the hurdle with the size of the shortfall
Done when the ranked table is produced with hurdle breaches flagged
verify: Confirm the hurdle rate applied matches the approved target
Pass when every channel below the hurdle is flagged in the ranking

steps.title: Review the economics output with the Head of Distribution and release it
sop: Walk the acquisition cost, cost-to-serve and margin results channel by channel
Challenge the allocation bases where a result looks driven by allocation rather than performance
Approve the model version for use in the strategy and investment work
Done when the economics model version is approved and released
verify: Check the model version and approval date are recorded on the cover tab
Pass when the released version carries the approver name and date

generic.Defined scope/population: All review comments received on the channel-segment strategy from every circulated stakeholder group
generic.In-scope period: From the opening of the review window to the issue of the revised strategy version
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Raiser, channel affected, comment, disposition and owner populated on every log entry
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Log entry count equals the number of comments received across all review channels
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revised strategy issued with tracked changes and a version number tied to the feedback log
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected and deferred items carry a written reason returned to the original commenter
generic.Test population: Every entry in the channel strategy feedback log for this review round
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero log entries without a disposition once the revision is issued
generic.Exception handling path: Comments needing a decision above the owner are escalated to the Head of Distribution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Feedback log lists every comment with disposition and owner and accepted changes are applied
generic.Evidence location: Feedback log workbook and the tracked-change strategy revision in the strategy folder

steps.title: Consolidate all review comments into a single feedback log in Microsoft Excel
sop: Collect comments from email, review sessions and CRM notes into one log
Create columns for raiser, channel affected, comment, disposition and owner
De-duplicate identical points raised by more than one reviewer and note both raisers
Done when every comment received sits in the single feedback log
verify: Compare the log entry count to the comments received across all sources
Pass when no received comment is missing from the log

steps.title: Mark each item Accepted, Rejected or Deferred with a reason
sop: Work through the log assigning a disposition to each item
Record the reason for every Rejected or Deferred item in the log
Assign an owner to each Accepted item so the change has a named implementer
Done when every log item carries a disposition, reason where needed and an owner
verify: Filter the log for blank dispositions or missing reasons
Pass when no item lacks a disposition or a required reason

steps.title: Apply accepted changes to the strategy document with tracked changes
sop: Edit the strategy document with tracked changes so reviewers can see what moved
Reference the log item number against each applied change
Increment the document version and date the revision
Done when all accepted changes are applied with tracked changes and a new version number
verify: Check each Accepted log item appears as a tracked change in the document
Pass when every Accepted item is traceable to a document change

steps.title: Re-run affected channel mix and target numbers rather than editing narrative
sop: Identify accepted changes that alter a channel mix percentage or target figure
Recompute the affected figures in the underlying model and reload them into the document
Check the revised figures still reconcile to the corporate plan total
Done when every number affected by an accepted change is recomputed
verify: Reconcile the revised channel targets to the plan total
Pass when the revised numbers reconcile and match the model output

steps.title: Log the disposition decisions against the CRM stakeholder records
sop: Record the disposition against each commenting stakeholder in the CRM engagement record
Note the strategy version in which their point was addressed
Keep the CRM record consistent with the feedback log wording
Done when every commenting stakeholder has their disposition recorded in CRM
verify: Sample CRM records against the feedback log entries
Pass when the CRM disposition matches the log for every sampled item

steps.title: Return the disposition log to commenters and close the round
sop: Issue the completed disposition log with the revised strategy to every original commenter
State that the round is closed and how to raise anything genuinely new
Confirm no open item remains without an owner and a due date
Done when the disposition log is returned and the review round is closed
verify: Check the issue record covers every commenter on the log
Pass when all commenters received the disposition log and no item is open without an owner

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force and quoted business cross-tabulated by customer segment and acquisition channel

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segment-channel cell totals reconcile to total in-force policy count and premium

steps.title: Cross-tabulate policy count and premium by segment and channel in the EDW
sop: Query the EDW for policy count and premium by customer segment and acquisition channel
Restrict the query to the trailing twenty-four months of activity
Save the query text with the analysis pack so the pull is reproducible
Done when the segment-by-channel volume cross-tab is produced and the query saved
verify: Reconcile the cross-tab totals to in-force policy count and premium
Pass when the cross-tab totals tie to the in-force control totals

steps.title: Layer quote-to-bind conversion by segment and channel from CRM data
sop: Pull quote and bind counts by segment and channel from CRM opportunity data

Align the CRM period boundaries to the EDW extract period

verify: Check period alignment between the CRM and EDW extracts

steps.title: Confirm no personally identifiable field leaves the governed environment

verify: Scan the published output columns for identifier fields

steps.title: Identify segments where observed buying channel diverges from carrier investment
sop: Compare the observed channel share per segment to the current channel investment allocation
List segments where the divergence is material against the agreed threshold
Note the premium at stake for each divergence so it can be prioritised
Done when every material divergence is listed with its premium impact
verify: Check the divergence threshold applied is the agreed one

steps.title: Build the segment-by-channel preference heat map in the BI platform
sop: Publish the heat map with conversion rate as the colour measure
Show the sample size in every cell so thin cells are not over-read
Suppress or grey cells below the minimum sample threshold
Done when the heat map is published with sample sizes visible
verify: Check a sample of cells for a displayed sample size

steps.title: Review the preference map with the Head of Distribution and log follow-ups
sop: Walk the divergences and the thin-cell caveats with the Market Research Analyst and Distribution Analyst
Agree which divergences feed the channel strategy and which need more evidence
Record the agreed follow-up actions with owners
Done when the map is reviewed and follow-up actions are recorded
verify: Check each agreed follow-up carries an owner and a date

steps.title: Clear the field-facing summary for unapproved product or commission claims

Close the CRM record only once the decision is reflected in the strategy document

Done when every settled issue is recorded and closed in CRM

steps.title: Update the strategy document and close the issues in the log
sop: Apply each settled decision to the affected section of the strategy document
Increment the document version and note the issues resolved in the change log
Close each issue in the conflict log with the closure date
Done when the strategy reflects every settled decision and the issues are closed
verify: Check each closed issue for a named decision-maker and a document change
Pass when no issue is closed without a named decision-maker recorded

generic.Defined scope/population: The final channel-segment strategy, its decision log and the associated investment ask
generic.In-scope period: The executive distribution forum cycle in which the strategy is tabled and approved
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver name, authority level, decision, conditions and effective date recorded in the minutes
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Investment ask in the pack equals the amount recorded as approved in the minutes
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Minute extract or e-signature filed with the dated strategy pack version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conditions attached to the approval logged as tracked actions with owners and due dates
generic.Test population: The approval record and all conditions attached to the channel strategy sign-off
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approver authority covers the full investment amount and written evidence exists
generic.Exception handling path: Amounts above the approver's limit route to the higher forum before any release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off evidence names approver, date and conditions and is filed with the strategy pack
generic.Evidence location: Executive forum minutes, the e-signature record and the filed strategy pack

steps.title: Table the final strategy, decision log and investment ask at the executive forum
sop: Submit the final strategy, the numbered decision log and the investment ask to the forum secretary
Confirm the pack meets the forum deadline and reaches the standing membership
Present the decision requests in the numbered order of the log

verify: Check the forum agenda and circulation record
Pass when the pack was circulated to the full membership before the deadline

steps.title: Confirm the approver authority against the delegation of authority matrix
sop: Read the total investment amount from the ask and locate the matching authority band
Confirm the intended approver holds that authority level
Route the decision upward where the amount exceeds the band
Done when the approving authority is confirmed as sufficient for the amount
verify: Compare the amount to the delegation of authority matrix band
Pass when the recorded approver sits at or above the required authority level

steps.title: Capture the approval outcome and conditions in the meeting minutes
sop: Record the decision against each numbered item in the decision log
Note any condition attached and the effective date of the approval
Confirm the minute wording with the forum chair before it is finalised
Done when the outcome, conditions and effective date are minuted
verify: Read the minutes for the decision, conditions and effective date
Pass when all three are present against the strategy item

steps.title: Obtain the written or system-recorded sign-off
sop: Obtain a minute extract or e-signature evidencing the approval
Confirm the evidence names the approver and carries the approval date
Reject a verbal confirmation as sufficient evidence
Done when written or system-recorded sign-off evidence exists
verify: Inspect the sign-off artefact for approver name and date
Pass when the evidence is written or system-recorded rather than verbal

steps.title: Log approval conditions as tracked actions in the BI action register
sop: Create a tracked action for each condition attached to the approval
Assign an owner and due date to each condition
Publish the condition status to the distribution governance reporting
Done when every condition is a tracked action with an owner and due date
verify: Compare the tracked actions to the conditions in the minutes
Pass when every minuted condition has a matching tracked action

steps.title: File the sign-off evidence with the published strategy pack
sop: Store the minute extract or e-signature alongside the approved strategy pack
Cross-reference the evidence in the document register entry
Confirm the filed pack version matches the version approved
Done when the sign-off evidence is filed against the correct pack version
verify: Open the filed pack and locate the sign-off evidence
Pass when the evidence is present and tied to the approved version

generic.Defined scope/population: The full in-force customer and policy base held in the enterprise data warehouse

generic.Exception handling path: Unassignable records are routed to data management for attribute remediation before publication

generic.Evidence location: EDW segmentation table, BI segment profile report and the published reference data entry

steps.title: Extract the in-force customer and policy base from the EDW

Set the as-at date and record it with the extract
Reconcile the extracted customer and premium totals to the in-force reporting

verify: Compare extract totals to the in-force control report

verify: Test the rule set for overlap across adjacent segments

verify: Compare profiles across adjacent segments

sop: Derive historical conversion and average premium by segment where data exists
